name: Chick-fil-A
disclaimer_extra: Chick-fil-A publishes its buns, proteins, toppings, sauces and dressings as separate component tables alongside its finished menu items; this builder uses those component tables, so a sandwich you assemble here may differ slightly from the published total for a comparable menu item. Drinks, coffee, treats, catering and whole menu items are published but not included. One known gap: Chick-fil-A's sandwiches are served with pickles, but pickles are not published as a separate topping — a sandwich built here reads roughly 100 mg lower in sodium than the equivalent published menu item.
blurb: Start from a Chick-fil-A menu item at its published nutrition — swap the cheese or the chicken and the numbers stay Chick-fil-A's own — or build a sandwich from their bun, filet and topping tables.
